name: double track-tunnel coupling
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 两条线路与隧道之间的动力联系。

complete_examples.text: Compared to previous work, an emphasis is put on the modelling of the mountain tunnel composed of multiple arcs, and a convenient double track-tunnel coupling strategy based on the spatial symmetry of track configurations in the tunnel is proposed.
